user.title: Bird Buddy account
user.description: Sign in with your Bird Buddy account. Accounts created through Google or Facebook sign-in are not supported; invite a separate email account as a member instead.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Bird Buddy API.
error.no_feeders: No feeders found on this account.

init.title: Livestream options
init.description: The feeder streams on battery power, so the livestream is stopped automatically. Set a go2rtc address (for example http://192.168.1.10:1984) to route the stream through it, which is more stable and works in every browser.

data.start_timeout: Wait for the stream at most
data.instant_start: Open the stream on the first click

data_description.start_timeout: A sleeping feeder on a weak signal may need well over a minute.
data_description.go2rtc_url: Leave empty to let Home Assistant read the HLS stream directly.
data_description.go2rtc_input: Name of an ffmpeg template defined in go2rtc.yaml. Leave empty unless you know you need it.
data_description.transcode: The feeder sends HEVC, which only plays in Safari without transcoding.
data_description.preview_source: What the camera card shows while nobody is watching.
data_description.preview_entity: Used with 'Latest postcard'. Pick an entity that has a picture, such as the recent visitor sensor from ha-birdbuddy.
data_description.preview_file: Used with 'Image file'. Full path to a JPEG or PNG in an allowed directory, for example /media/local/birdbuddy.jpg
data_description.status_overlay: Writes 'Waking up', 'Live' and similar across the bottom of the preview.
data_description.instant_start: Requires go2rtc. Shows a holding pattern while the feeder wakes, then swaps in the live picture automatically.
data_description.placeholder_source: go2rtc source shown while waking. Leave empty for the default test pattern. No spaces allowed.
data_description.stop_when_unwatched: Requires go2rtc. Experimental: an empty viewer list can also mean the stream briefly dropped, which cuts off someone who is still watching. The stop timer already protects the battery.
data_description.continuous: For feeders on permanent power. Keeps the stream up for something like Frigate. Bird Buddy records no postcards while streaming, and the feeder still sleeps at night.
data_description.retry_interval: How long to wait before trying again after a failed start, or while the feeder is asleep.

options.last_frame: Last frame of the previous stream
options.entity: Latest postcard or other entity picture
